title: Stochastic Mirror Descent under Dependent Observations
abstract: arXiv:2610.41251v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the non-asymptotic convergence of Stochastic Mirror Descent (SMD) algorithm when the noisy first-order oracle is driven by dependent observations. Departing from the classical i.i.d. assumption underlying most existing guarantees, we introduce a flexible ``forgetting" condition that accommodates geometrically or polynomially dependent sequences. Under this condition we derive explicit finite-sample accuracy bounds for the averaged SMD iterates, recovering the classical $O(1/T)$ and $O(1/\sqrt{T})$ rates in the large- and small-initial-error regimes. We instantiate the general framework on two applications: high-dimensional linear regression with dependent regressors and nonparametric estimation of the drift function of a functional autoregressive model.

translated_title: 相关观测下的随机镜像下降
translated_abstract: 我们研究了当带噪一阶预言机由相关观测驱动时，随机镜像下降（SMD）算法的非渐近收敛性。与现有大多数理论保证所依赖的经典独立同分布（i.i.d.）假设不同，我们引入了一个灵活的“遗忘”条件，该条件能够容纳几何相关或多项式相关的序列。在该条件下，我们推导出了平均化SMD迭代点的显式有限样本精度界，在大初始误差和小初始误差两种情形下分别恢复了经典的 O(1/T) 和 O(1/√T) 收敛速率。我们将该通用框架应用于两个具体实例：具有相关回归变量的高维线性回归，以及函数型自回归模型漂移函数的非参数估计。
tldr: 该论文突破了传统独立同分布假设，通过引入适用于几何或多项式相关序列的灵活“遗忘”条件，在相关观测下建立了随机镜像下降算法的显式有限样本收敛界，并恢复了经典的 O(1/T) 与 O(1/√T) 收敛速率。
en_tdlr: This paper relaxes the classical i.i.d. assumption by introducing a flexible "forgetting" condition that accommodates geometrically or polynomially dependent sequences, under which it derives explicit finite-sample convergence bounds for Stochastic Mirror Descent, recovering the classical O(1/T) and O(1/√T) rates.
